title: smallRNAseq-DREAM: Comprehensive microRNA and Non-Coding RNA Audit across NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) Plant Spaceflight Datasets
description: This repository provides a reproducible computational framework and dataset audit for microRNAs (miRNAs) and non-coding RNAs (ncRNAs) in plant spaceflight biological data from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR). The analysis integrates dedicated small RNA-Seq (OSD-437) with 11 bulk RNA-Seq spaceflight experiments across Arabidopsis thaliana, Solanum lycopersicum, and Brachypodium distachyon, constructing miRNA-mRNA inverse regulatory target networks and assessing cellular pathway enrichment in response to microgravity, space radiation, and spaceflight hardware environments.
